study.question: Does preserving the direction of separate category/brand/action/recency group means help after target-match conditioning, beyond field-contrast energy, and does that effect differ from size-matched positional grouping?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent sums four field embeddings in each learned mean and uses only a product of content and context marginal means; category-versus-brand and action-versus-recency directions remain collapsed. Conditional field direction may add useful information within semantic groups. This is deliberately provisional: r0001 field_values AUC 0.61318549 was below collapsed_values 0.61331127 despite contrast-energy fraction 0.7198 in candidate diagnostics. The current question changes the conditioning context, not that negative observation. r0005 semantic means 0.61879989 exceeded rank means 0.61692269; r0007 independent_match 0.61924392 exceeded paired_match 0.61905559, while paired_rank 0.61917486 exceeded independent_rank 0.61905050. These mixed small changes do not establish event-pairing utility. Source inspection identifies an algebraic many-to-one field sum, not a measured predictive defect. Trajectory review: behavior_within (0.61191289) did not beat DIN (0.61336199); r0002 joint_count (0.61712722) and independent_count (0.61712298) were nearly tied, while joint_rate fell to 0.61475606. Removing learned history content in r0003 count_summary fell to 0.61309455 and activity_summary to 0.60537377. r0004 mean_match (0.61651947) was below its attention-plus-count ancestor; r0005 match_groups (0.61879989) recovered quality relative to rank (0.61692269) and occupied_global (0.61744193). These are separate architecture/information contrasts with unsuccessful branches, not repetitions or proof that more granular representations always help. Existing receipts report successful execution; adverse scientific results remain part of the record.

nearest_work.difference: Group-wise embedding/pooling followed by concatenation is established prior work, as is target-aware pooling. Proposed fixed contrasts are merely a linear re-expression of separate field means conditional on existing exact-match groups. No novelty or DIN reproduction claim; baseline_reference.py uses normalized attention, unlike the original unnormalized local activation.

nearest_work.source_ref: g1-r0001-field_values; trial receipt and candidate diagnostic values
nearest_work.difference: Earlier shared global attention with four value-field summaries did not improve over collapse. Current conditional mean summaries sit beside fixed counts/histograms/marginal products; a complete membership factorial and per-group norm control test the changed context. Ancestor r0001 source is unavailable here, so no source-level equivalence is asserted.
Retain its entire feature representation and add linear field contrasts, not observed event products. No claim that mean separation recovers within-event associations or the full history.

UniTokenFormer jointly projects fields and allocates tokens with gated sequence decoding. Here there are fixed signed mean contrasts, no learned token allocation/decoder, no additional supervision and no system transfer claim. Detailed participant implementation is unavailable; broader architectural novelty remains unverified.
Author README confirms histories lack item identity. Only supplied category, brand, action and age are used. Full paper was blocked; no DMR mechanism reproduction is claimed.

inherited_components: Baseline field embeddings shared with category/brand history tables; action and log2-age embeddings; shallow MLP.
From r0002: four count features log1p-scaled by log(129); from r0005: four mutually exclusive target category/brand match means.
From r0006: observed 4x4 action/coarse-age histograms in each true-match group.
From r0007 incumbent: half the product of content and context mean embeddings in true-match groups; independent pairing fixed.
Dormant attention parameters retained without execution; host data/scoring/optimization information boundary unchanged.
study.proposed_difference: For each selected group pool four d-dimensional means c,b,a,r. Preserve the parent sum in its original slots. Add H1=(c+b-a-r)/2, H2=(c-b+a-r)/2, H3=(c-b-a+r)/2, totaling 4*3*d=192 inputs. Together with half the sum these form an orthonormal Hadamard basis, equivalent to separate field means, not a new interaction. Norm controls replace this 3xd block by three copies of (c+b+a+r)/2, rescaled to its exact contrast-block norm; a fixed first-coordinate basis handles near-zero sums. This control retains energy while erasing contrast directions. Cross this with true-match vs deterministic same-cardinality rank membership ONLY for the new readout. All old features are fixed. All four cells compute both alternatives. Extra allocation=192*128=24576 weights, predicted total=17177891. There is no new optimizer/loss, event scorer, external input or history expansion.
predictions: Full contrast readouts should exceed norm-only controls within semantic groups if missing field directions are useful; nonzero energy alone is insufficient.
A stronger full-minus-norm effect for semantic than rank membership is predicted by the conditional mechanism; the 2x2 interaction is the mechanism contrast.

Full contrast plus half-sum reconstructs all four pooled fields within floating tolerance; control has the same norm per group but generally fails directional reconstruction. Padding and empty histories give zero added features; all cardinalities agree.

True-match field summaries, parent features and logits should be invariant up to rounding under whole-sequence reversal and complete context-bundle reversal within true-match groups. Rank features may change; this is expected positional dependence.
Readout cost and parameters increase over incumbent; expect roughly 700-1000 host seconds per trial, not yet measured. No efficiency win without measured quality-cost evidence.
falsifiers: Full contrast does not exceed its norm-matched control, or improvement is confined to norm-only control: directional field utility is unsupported at this training recipe.
A nonpositive semantic-minus-rank difference-in-differences weakens the semantic-conditioning explanation even if a generic field effect exists.

Failure of reconstruction, norm matching, padding/empty checks, exact group cardinalities, finite diagnostics/logits or host gradient checks invalidates the implementation rather than refuting the mechanism.
Paired seed variation absorbs the apparent AUC gain, material Logloss degradation, or no useful measured cost-quality tradeoff prevents promoting the candidate.
Contrast energy or diagnostic perturbation sensitivity without held-recipe predictive contrasts cannot establish a mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Earlier null field separation may persist; predictive statistics may already be captured by counts and observed action-age tables.
The wide control can change conditioning, regularization or embedding gradients even without directional field access; matching norms and allocation does not remove all optimization effects.

Rank membership can encode supplied order/recency rather than target relevance. Most diagnostic histories are capped: 85.16% at 128 in first 512 impressions; conclusions concern only that supplied prefix, not unseen older events.
A single adaptive seed-42 validation optimum may be noise or selection bias; diagnostics on first 512 are candidate-supplied exploratory checks and not population or independent evidence.
Publisher static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; frozen benchmark availability is not verified production point-in-time availability.

The additive embeddings are trainable and could learn field-specific subspaces. A many-to-one sum for arbitrary fixed vectors does not prove information loss in the learned model or in the full parent representation (which also includes static fields and products). Some semantic-group field means are already recoverable from target embeddings. Any gain may reflect easier optimization of redundant information.

Raw physical data and host execution are not exported to this coding phase. Reliable starting evidence consists of frozen host success receipts, declared protocol and exact incumbent source hash, not a fresh local baseline rerun. The author README is a schema warning, not a local data audit. No missing raw input is misclassified as a failed experiment.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: A positive difference-in-differences, replicated with paired seeds, would support conditional utility of field direction in semantic groups. Inspect pre-existing slices, including sparse histories and missing target brand, with counts and user-cluster uncertainty where available.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Equal field benefits suggest a generic field-direction effect; equal/null benefits weaken the semantic-conditioning explanation. A rank advantage motivates a positional-information explanation, not semantic grouping support.
